consent.mechanism: localStorage key jft_cookie_choice, must equal 'accepted' before GA4 script tag is created or gtag('config',...) is called
consent.withdrawal_behavior: clears stored choice, re-shows bar, calls gtag('consent','update',{analytics_storage:'denied'}) if gtag already loaded
consent.classification: TECHNICAL - verified as implemented; no legal/compliance conclusion offered

performance.duplicate_load_fix_impact: removes one redundant script fetch (and, post-consent, one redundant gtag.js fetch) on 22 pages

findings.title: Duplicate jft-conversion.js execution on 22 pages
findings.evidence: buyer-security.html and export-documentation.html (+10 locale copies each) had a direct <script src=jft-conversion.js> tag in addition to the header-injection delivery that already exists correctly on every other page
findings.consequence: click-based events and the form_start intent event fired twice on these 22 pages; gtag.js library and config call also loaded twice
findings.fix: removed the redundant direct script tag; header.html's injection remains the sole, correct delivery mechanism

findings.title: Category pages lack a structured custom view event
findings.reason: automatic pageview already allows path-based analysis; adding a new event type is a taxonomy expansion without a demonstrated business need beyond what exists

findings.title: Calculators lack tool_start/tool_complete granularity
findings.reason: existing tool-to-RFQ bridge event already covers the highest-value signal; finer granularity not demonstrated as needed
